stage: Stage 2B.2b player fire cadence + shot SFX cross-sector fix

shot SFX phase ownership and boundary cadence
Raider regression harness updated to initialise the current 27-row $8140 ring rather than stale pre-ring addresses

ring, debris, capital and boss gameplay

open_space_trace.method: instruction-exact XEX host trace, 6000 frames per mode and movement; continuous FIRE

SPREAD.lifetime_note: lateral Spread cells can leave the playfield before the vertical 35-frame envelope

open_space_trace.interval_explanation: The two ordinary values are intentional intra-burst cadence and the 12-frame post-burst pause. Movement and world/ring-step phase do not change them.
open_space_trace.pool_saturation_correlation: REJECTED; Rapid legally reaches all five slots but produces zero denied admissions

sequence: the loop latches fighter OPEN publication at frame start
integration_update_first_capital changes OPEN(7) to ENGINES(0) in the middle of that loop
the outgoing path waits through VCOUNT $77 at the end of the frame
the next capital loop waits again at VCOUNT $70
one physical PAL frame therefore had no player burst-controller tick
root_causes.effect: a cadence interval crossing the boundary gained one unexplained frame

sequence: POKEY address $D200 is AUDF1 on write but POT0 on read
the NMOS 6502 read-modify-write therefore incremented paddle input, not the previous frequency
root_causes.effect: native traces observed input-dependent values such as $E5 instead of the intended $33..$38 tail; the last tone was not reliable

fix.burst: Expose the existing burst-controller core after input admission. On the one outgoing OPEN loop which has already admitted ENGINES(0), advance only an already-active FIRING/POST burst after the $77 wait. WAITING remains a no-op and TRIG0 is not sampled a second time.
fix.audio_clock: On that same boundary loop, tick update_sound once before the $77 wait and retain the ordinary tick after it. The two calls lie on opposite physical PAL frames; all other loops retain one call.
fix.audio_phase: Store the current shot frequency phase in fire_timer. Accepted fire starts at $32; update_sound writes the six full tones $33,$34,$35,$36,$37,$38 and clears at $39 without reading AUDF1.
fix.allocation_semantics: The SFX trigger remains after a successful PairShot allocation; denied allocation cannot trigger it.

transition_native_trace.note: The trace still labels one two-host-frame main-loop cadence at each intentional $77->$70 handoff (3 total), but controller/audio catch-up covers the physical boundary; extra VBI remains zero.

memory_placement.transport: DFMC-v1 unchanged; existing four records; no BASIC RAM or loader logic change

regression.artifact_build: assembly, link, XEX/ATR validation and all current placement assertions PASS through the focused build/native-trace path
regression.standard_build_note: The monolithic npm run build still enters the pre-existing legacy CPU replay and follows integration-glue.s's hard-coded entity_spawn_debris=$98FF while the unchanged current symbol is $98C0. That out-of-scope debris ABI/harness path predates this CODE/BROADSIDE-only fix; it was not altered or masked here.
regression.harness_correction: The Raider harness now initialises and scans the production 27-row ring at $8140; the prior 22-row $4050 model left five row pointers dependent on cold staging bytes. No production starfield/ring code changed.

decision: Player fire cadence and shot SFX handoff are technically viable and pass the bounded regression/native gates.
